claim: The T016 lane has a bounded security acceptance charter and explicit no-go conditions before runtime implementation.
method: Derive controls from T016 task, ADR-0002 and the T015 stable JWT/role contract.
acceptance: authorization-code redirect validates state, nonce, exact redirect URI and PKCE code_verifier
tokens stay server-side; browser receives only Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite session cookies
session rotation occurs after login and privilege/context changes; logout revokes/clears server session
CSRF protection covers cookie-authenticated state-changing requests and is tested for missing/invalid/replayed tokens
auth middleware preserves anonymous public SSR reading and never leaks token/error details
provider outage blocks login only and returns a safe stable problem; anonymous published reading remains available
integration tests cover replay, fixation, open redirect, cookie flags, CSRF and role mapping using a local OIDC stub
no production IdP, client secret, token, cookie, private key or personal data is accessed
dependency_edges: T015 terminal main -> T016 issuer/audience/role contract
T016 lane || T018 outbox lane (parallel, non-blocking)
stop_conditions: any request to contact production IdP or use a production secret
any browser token storage or cookie without Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite policy
any attempt to weaken T015 role or public-route fail-closed behavior
any change outside allowed T016 paths or loop artifacts
